operation.name: pcc
operation.description:
Run the Photometric Color Correction on the loaded plate-solved image.

The limit magnitude of stars is automatically computed from the size of the field of view, but can be altered by passing a +offset or -offset value to -limitmag= , or simply an absolute positive value for the limit magnitude.

The star catalog used is NOMAD by default, it can be changed by providing -catalog=apass , -catalog=localgaia or -catalog=gaia . If installed locally, the remote NOMAD (the complete version) can be forced by providing -catalog=nomad

Background reference outlier tolerance can be specified in sigma units using -bgtol=lower,upper : these default to -2.8 and +2.0

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

help:
Siril 1.4.4. Run the Photometric Color Correction on the loaded plate-solved image.

The limit magnitude of stars is automatically computed from the size of the field of view, but can be altered by passing a +offset or -offset value to -limitmag= , or simply an absolute positive value for the limit magnitude.

The star catalog used is NOMAD by default, it can be changed by providing -catalog=apass , -catalog=localgaia or -catalog=gaia . If installed locally, the remote NOMAD (the complete version) can be forced by providing -catalog=nomad

Background reference outlier tolerance can be specified in sigma units using -bgtol=lower,upper : these default to -2.8 and +2.0

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

Plate-solved input and the catalogue/response data selected in the isolated settings.

runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Connect transforms to an explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoint. Only requested dependencies are executed; previews do not make other branches endpoints. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
dependencies: Plate-solved input and the catalogue/response data selected in the isolated settings.
